profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm friendly, funny and always learning. Drop me a line if you've got something in mind. 

I'm specifically interested in for Senior Software Engineer and Engineering Manager roles.

positions.title: Travel
positions.description:
Designed and launched an open-source eSports scheduling platform (https://www.harmony-schedlr.com/) serving nearly 6,000 players across mobile and desktop. Built with Typescript, NextJs, Kotlin, Spring boot and PostgreSQL. Invested time in family, got married and traveled for 8 months (17 countries, 21 cities). 

Tech used: Kotlin, Spring boot, NextJs, React, Typescript, Docker, PostgreSQL, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Launched the auto loan product. Scaled through IPO and nationwide rollout to all US states. Led successive 8-10 person teams. Owned team agile ceremonies, drove sprint planning, and coordinated complex feature delivery end-to-end. Mentored junior engineers through pair programming and code review. Partnered with product, design and dealership teams to deliver an internal tool mapping dealership products to purchase contracts. 

Tech used: Ruby on Rails, AWS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Python, Git
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · Git · React.js · Node.js · PostgreSQL · SQL · TypeScript · Ruby on Rails · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Artisan
positions.description:
Built high-impact proofs of concept for global clients in consumer tech and healthcare. 

Pillar Technology was acquired by Accenture.

Tech used: Node.js, Android, Java, JavaScript, Python, AWS (Transcribe), Alexa SDK, SQL, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered full-stack features for internal new hire background check platform (Java, Spring, JSF/PrimeFaces, Oracle DB) supporting 250,000 employees. Significantly improved pre-release bug detection by optimizing internal automated testing platform (Jenkins + Cucumber + Selenium) resulting in a 71% reduction in manual QA headcount (from 35 to 10).

Tech used: Java, Spring, JSF/PrimeFaces, Oracle DB, Cucumber, Selenium, Jenkins, Maven, Tomcat, JUnit/Mockito, Git
positions.insights: Skills: Cucumber · SQL · Java · Jenkins · Spring Boot · Oracle Database · Selenium · Spring Framework

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Owned identity and access management for ~10,000 employee accounts. Built Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) agents to automate the full employee access lifecycle — from new hire provisioning to role change to termination. Developed and maintained an internal .NET web app for bespoke employee access requests.

Tech used: C#, .NET, PowerShell, Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM)

positions.title: IS Technical Support Analyst
positions.description: Skills: Troubleshooting · Remote Troubleshooting · CompTIA A+ Certification · Technical Support

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant (Software Dev)
positions.description:
Contributed to behavioral research mapping the limits of rational decision-making. Wrote R scripts to augment SPSS software in analyzing data from research. Pioneered development of a cross-platform (C#, Xamarin, MySQL, PHP) mobile app to support health data collection.

Tech used: R, SPSS, C#, Xamarin, MySQL, PHP
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Android Development · R (Programming Language) · Xamarin Products · MySQL · PHP · SPSS Statistics · iOS Development

projects.title: OSU CAPLab mHealth mobile application
projects.description:
mHealth is an application created to aid in conducting studies at the Ohio State University School of Communication.

The application is written for iOS and Android in C# and Xamarin.
